name: Oma's Supreme Pizza
description: Signature loaded pizza with smoked chicken chunks, pepperoni slices, mushrooms, black olives, bell peppers, and 100% pure mozzarella cheese.

name: Smoked BBQ Chicken Pizza
description: Tender grilled BBQ chicken breast with smoky barbecue drizzle, red onions, sweet corn, and melted golden cheddar and mozzarella.

name: Double Beef Smash Burger
description: Two juicy 100% prime beef patties smashed crispy, double American cheddar cheese, caramelized onions, dill pickles, and Oma's secret sauce.

name: Mega Crispy Zinger Burger
description: Ultra crispy double-dredged chicken fillet, spiced with fiery seasoning, crisp iceberg lettuce, and creamy garlic-chili mayo in a toasted brioche bun.

name: Special Grilled Chicken Shawarma
description: Char-roasted marinated chicken strips wrapped in fresh pita with authentic garlic tahini sauce, pickled cucumber, and crispy fries inside.

name: Oma's Loaded Cheesy Fries
description: Crispy golden crinkle fries smothered in warm molten cheddar cheese sauce, grilled chicken bits, sliced jalapeños, and smoky drizzle.

name: Fiery Buffalo Chicken Wings (8 Pcs)
description: Crispy jumbo chicken wings tossed in buttered tangy buffalo sauce, served with cool buttermilk ranch dip.

name: Triple Deck Club Sandwich
description: Three toasted bread slices layered with grilled chicken salad, fried farm egg, sliced cheddar cheese, fresh cucumber, and French fries.

name: Oma's Special Chicken Karahi (Full)
description: Prepared in pure butter wok with juicy bone-in chicken, fresh plum tomatoes, crushed ginger, julienned green chilies, and freshly roasted black pepper.

name: Mutton Shinwari Karahi
description: Authentic Khyber Shinwari style tender mutton braised in its own rich juices, ripe tomatoes, green chilies, and rock salt. Pure traditional delicacy.

name: Charcoal Chicken Tikka (Chest)
description: Quarter chicken breast marinated overnight in Lahori yogurt spice blend, flame-grilled on coal embers. Served with mint raita and fresh salad.

name: Creamy Chicken Malai Boti (10 Pcs)
description: Melt-in-mouth boneless chicken cubes marinated in heavy fresh cream, white pepper, aromatic herbs, and lightly smoked over charcoal.

name: Grilled Seekh Kabab Platter (4 Pcs)
description: Succulent minced meat skewers blended with fresh coriander, roasted cumin, pomegranate seeds, and charcoal smoke aroma.

name: Special Chicken Dum Biryani
description: Long-grain sella basmati rice layered with aromatic saffron, whole spices, caramelized onions, and succulent chicken pieces slow-cooked in dum.

name: Special Chicken Chowmein
description: Stir-fried authentic egg noodles tossed on high wok heat with shredded chicken, crunchy cabbage, bell peppers, carrots, and dark savory soya sauce.

name: Egg & Chicken Fried Rice
description: Fluffy wok-tossed jasmine rice stir-fried with scrambled eggs, chicken bits, spring onions, peas, and fragrant sesame oil aroma.

name: Chicken Manchurian with Fried Rice
description: Crispy fried chicken balls in rich, tangy-sweet and mildly spicy Chinese red sauce with garlic, served with piping hot egg fried rice.

name: Chicken Shashlik with Garlic Rice
description: Tender boneless chicken skewers tossed with sweet onions and green peppers in a thick sweet-sour tomato glaze, served with butter garlic rice.

name: Golden Crispy Spring Rolls (4 Pcs)
description: Crisp golden-fried pastry wrappers filled with seasoned shredded chicken and julienned vegetables. Served with sweet plum chili dip.

name: Chilled Mint Lemonade Margarita
description: Refreshing slush blend of fresh green garden mint, squeezed lemons, black rock salt, and bubbly soda over crushed crystal ice.

name: Thick Chocolate Oreo Milkshake
description: Creamy blend of whole milk, chocolate ice cream, crushed Oreo cookies, crowned with rich chocolate drizzle and whipped cream.

name: Chilled Soft Drinks (345ml Can)
description: Ice-cold canned beverage. Choice of Coca Cola, Sprite, or Fanta.
